description: Procurement of 28,000 vials of Trastuzumab Injection 440mg in 20ml vial (with solvent)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International competitive bids have been invited for the purchase of Trastuzumab Injection, which is used to treat certain types of cancers. Five bids have been received for the purpose. Based on the recommendation made by the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee regarding the relevant bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement to Cliniqon Biotech (Pvt) Ltd., Sri Lanka (Manufacturer: AryoGen Pharmed, Iran), the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, for a total cost of Rs.516.6 million, was approved by the Cabinet.
